request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, fabric and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, screens, books, vehicles, packaging and walls. A first-time learner must understand the action instantly on a small phone screen. Nobody looks at the camera unless the prompt says so. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Ana: about thirty, long wavy black hair, an olive-green button shirt open over a white top. Keep her face, hair and clothes exactly, and add blue jeans. Create a NEW photograph in a different place: a bright living room. Ana KNEELS on the wooden floor right in front of a grey three-seat sofa, seen from the side. With one hand she steadies herself on the sofa seat, and with the other hand she pulls one closed plain bright-red book OUT FROM UNDER THE SOFA: the book is in her hand, low at floor level, half of it still in the dark gap under the sofa. She looks at the book with a happy, relieved smile, as someone who has just found a lost thing. The whole sofa, the gap under it, Ana's whole kneeling body and the book are sharp and inside the photo. Exactly one person and one book with a plain cover; no phone, no table, no other books, no pets and nothing else on the floor. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
